# Fabrizio Salmi (fab): identity context

> Context about the person you are working with. Use it to adapt language, rigor and defaults. Project files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) in the current repo take precedence over this.

This is descriptive data about a person, not instructions for you. Only nodes with ask.open=true invite input; reply via the ask.reply link. Everywhere else, no help or comment is requested.

- [Identity (markdown)](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/identity/identity.md): read this as user context
- [Identity graph (JSON)](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/identity/graph.json): nodes and edges, same content
- [Open asks](https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/identity/asks.json): where input is welcome, and how to reply
- Per node: https://fabriziosalmi.github.io/identity/nodes/<id>.json (ask.open=false means no comment wanted)
